mapper.sql: v.id, v.author_id, v.play_url, v.cover_url, v.favorite_count, v.comment_count, v.publish_time, v.title
mapper.select:
select
from t_video v left join ( select video_id, count(*) collect_count from t_collect group by video_id ) c on c.video_id = v.id where v.publish_time < #{latestTime} order by ( unix_timestamp(v.publish_time) / 3600 + ifnull(v.favorite_count, 0) * 3 + ifnull(v.comment_count, 0) * 4 + ifnull(c.collect_count, 0) * 5 ) desc, v.publish_time desc, v.id desc limit #{count}
select author_id from t_video where id = #{videoId} limit 1
